story.summaryEn:
Welcoming Dynamo Capital to the team 🤝
We’re delighted to announce a new long-term partnership with the boutique private lender, specializing in high-performance financing for real estate investors across the United States 🇺🇸
"There are strong parallels with Dynamo Capital’s business, and we look forward to building a partnership that brings those shared values to life while creating meaningful opportunities to connect with more fans across the United States.” 🗣️ Ayao Komatsu
#HaasF1 #F1
detailZh:
欢迎Dynamo Capital加入车队 🤝
我们很高兴地宣布与专注于美国房地产投资者高性能融资的精品私人贷款机构Dynamo Capital达成一项新的长期合作伙伴关系 🇺🇸
"Dynamo Capital的业务与我们的业务有着强烈的相似之处，我们期待着建立一个能够将那些共同价值观付诸实践并创造更多与美国粉丝互动机会的合作伙伴关系。” 🗣️ 安东内利
#HaasF1 #F1
